script_reads: config/liver-atlas-sources.json: source file paths, declared H5AD hashes, retrieval metadata, and expected observation counts; collection and both H5AD files are byte/hash verified before metadata reads.
config/liver-atlas-plan.json: selected SC/SN dataset IDs, versions, and expected observation counts.
data/raw/liver-atlas/cellxgene-collection.json: public collection inventory, dataset assets, modalities, donor IDs, and ontology cell-type labels; curator contact fields are omitted from the report.
data/raw/liver-atlas/psc-sc-ff713455.h5ad and psc-sn-34702b40.h5ad: backed obs plus shape/raw-shape metadata only; matrix values are never materialized.
data/derived/geo-library-metadata.csv: exact pinned bytes/SHA-256 are verified before parsing; all original GEO columns are retained and title/description conflict counts are parsed mechanically.
author_and_paper_evidence_pinned_in_conf: Author repository file contents, commit metadata, local snapshot hashes, declared SC donor vector, and annotation-process descriptions are pinned in config/liver-atlas-metadata.json; the script does not re-execute the R code.
The final-paper citation and abstract counts are pinned in config/liver-atlas-metadata.json; the script does not derive paper counts from H5AD metadata.

The 24 control donor labels and duplicate/quality notes come from a preprint supplementary workbook pinned in config/liver-atlas-metadata.json; they are not treated as final-paper supplementary values.

cross_dataset_donor_overlap.independence_note: Shared donor labels are not independent sc/sn biological replicates; cell IDs are release-specific.

paper_vs_release_counts.scope_interpretation: PSC/PBC counts agree with the paper abstract; distributed normal-cell scope is a six-donor atlas release and is smaller than the paper's 24-donor healthy comparison.
Distributed nuclei counts exceed the paper abstract counts; the release and paper subset/QC scope cannot be reconciled from labels alone.

geo_reconciliation.crosswalk_rule: A matching donor string is a label-level link only; no exact GEO library identity is asserted.

code_evidence: CELLxGENE obs author_cell_type is treated as the original author label and cell_type/cell_type_ontology_term_id as supplied ontology annotations.
The inspected repository contains manual, scmap, and marker-based annotation code, but no explicit GEO sample-to-CELLxGENE library UUID crosswalk.

The author SC analysis donor vectors cover the same apparent donor inventory as the SC CELLxGENE release, but the source name PSC014X differs from CELLxGENE donor_id PSC014 and is retained as a naming discrepancy rather than silently normalized.

quality_findings.claim: SC disease and assay are completely confounded in the distributed object.
quality_findings.evidence: The SC disease-by-assay table has all normal cells in 10x 5' v1 and all PSC/PBC cells in 10x 5' v2.
quality_findings.impact: A PSC-versus-normal SC expression contrast cannot separate disease from the captured chemistry in this release.
quality_findings.action: Retain SC for within-assay descriptive summaries and block cross-assay PSC-normal contrasts.

quality_findings.claim: Distributed SN counts exceed the paper abstract counts for PSC and PBC.
quality_findings.evidence: The release has 57,511 PSC and 21,754 PBC nuclei; the paper reports approximately 23,000 PSC and 20,202 PBC nuclei.
quality_findings.impact: Release-level cells cannot be silently treated as the paper's reported QC subset.
quality_findings.action: Use pinned release counts, retain the paper comparison, and label scope/QC reconciliation unresolved.

quality_findings.claim: Several CELLxGENE processing fields differ systematically between normal controls and disease donors.
quality_findings.evidence: Normal cells/nuclei are is_primary_data=False while disease cells/nuclei are True; SN normal nuclei use NP40 or Tween-20 while cases use Tween-20, and normal alignment software is unknown while cases are Cell Ranger count v3.1.0. The CELLxGENE is_primary_data field is treated as reuse/provenance metadata, not as a quality label.
quality_findings.impact: Reference, pipeline, and preparation effects remain coupled to cohort labels in release metadata.
quality_findings.action: Keep these fields visible in donor tables and avoid attributing uncontrolled differences to PSC biology.

quality_findings.claim: The public objects retain author doublet/hybrid and unknown ontology groups.
quality_findings.evidence: The fixed metadata rules identify 4,623 SC and 7,927 SN doublet/hybrid-labelled observations, plus 5,527 SC and 8,765 SN unknown ontology observations.
quality_findings.impact: Cell-type denominators depend on the frozen metadata exclusions.
quality_findings.action: Use original labels and apply the frozen exclusions before candidate aggregation; report excluded counts.

quality_findings.claim: GEO title donor labels can be linked to CELLxGENE donor_id, but exact library identity is unresolved.
quality_findings.evidence: The author code declares the SC donor set used for disease analysis, while GEO exposes sample titles and generic source descriptions; no shared GEO accession or CELLxGENE library UUID mapping is present in the inspected code/metadata.
quality_findings.impact: GEO chemistry/description conflicts must remain source-specific and cannot be used to overwrite CELLxGENE assay fields.
quality_findings.action: Preserve GEO raw fields, report donor-label matches separately, and do not claim GEO-identical libraries.

quality_findings.claim: The author SC code and CELLxGENE release contain a donor-name variation for the PSC014 sample.
quality_findings.evidence: The pinned author SC input vector uses PSC014X while CELLxGENE donor_id uses PSC014; the source strings are retained independently.
quality_findings.impact: A donor-level provenance comparison must distinguish source naming from an asserted identity mapping.
quality_findings.action: Do not rewrite either source value; treat PSC014X/PSC014 as an unresolved naming variation unless an explicit primary-source crosswalk is found.

quality_findings.claim: Eight donor labels occur in both SC and SN releases.
quality_findings.evidence: The exact overlap is reported in cross_dataset_donor_overlap; no observation IDs are shared.
quality_findings.impact: SC and SN should be reported as separate modalities and not counted as independent donor replication.
quality_findings.action: Use donor-within-dataset units and disclose the overlap in downstream summaries.

next_evidence_needed: An explicit public sample/library crosswalk would be required to claim GEO-identical CELLxGENE libraries.
The paper's QC/subset definition would be required to reconcile distributed SN counts with abstract counts.
